Perform 5 sets of 3 power pull-ups, resting 1 minute between sets. 

Use a resistance band to provide assistance to your pull-up. Aim to get your chin clear over the bar and then lower down at a slower pace keeping your hands on the bar at all times and your feet in the band. The stiffness of the band should mean that you can powerfully pull up with speed for all reps in the set. 

Do not add weight to your body during this workout.  Due to the amount of lateral force generated in the pulling motion, this workout should only be performed on a floor-mounted pull-up bar.
